profile.headline: Software Engineer | Ads Serving, ML Systems, Distributed Systems | Real-Time Inference | Amazon Ads
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I build large-scale, low-latency systems at the intersection of ads, machine learning, and distributed infrastructure. At Amazon Ads, I work on ad serving and recommendation systems, focusing on real-time inference, retrieval, and high-throughput backend services. My work spans:
- Online model serving and ML integration
- Candidate retrieval (KNN vector search, inverted index systems)
- High-volume, low-latency distributed systems
- Experimentation platforms (A/B testing)

Previously, I built distributed backend systems and event-driven architectures supporting millions of requests, improving system scalability and reliability.

I’m particularly interested in:
- Real-time ML systems
- Ranking / recommendation systems
- High-scale distributed infrastructure

Always open to connecting with engineers working on ads, search, or ML systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Amazon Ads
positions.description:
Amazon Ads
- Designed and built a high-throughput, low-latency ad serving system supporting multiple surfaces and placements
- Developed distributed microservices (Java, gRPC) to handle high-volume, real-time ad requests at scale
- Built a configuration-driven experimentation platform (A/B testing) enabling rapid iteration without redeployments
- Collaborated with ML scientists to productionize recommendation and ranking models, integrating models into
online serving paths
- Designed and implemented online model serving infrastructure for real-time inference under strict latency constraints
- Built candidate retrieval pipelines using KNN-based vector search and inverted index systems (Lucene-style) for
scalable recommendation and ad matching
- Developed indexing pipelines for embeddings and metadata, enabling efficient nearest-neighbor search and filtering
at scale
- Integrated caching and optimized request flows to improve latency and throughput under high traffic
- Conducted performance tuning and benchmarking (I/O vs CPU, latency vs throughput) to improve system efficiency
and reliability
- Designed modular architectures separating core serving logic from model-specific and retrieval components,
improving extensibility
- Contributed to high availability and fault-tolerant system design for large-scale production environments
positions.insights: Data Pipelines, Software Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer - Amazon Devices
positions.description:
Design and implement services to improve shopping experience for Amazon Devices’ customers.

Project lead developer on full-stack web development project, the Invitation Platform.

The Invitation Platform enables customers to engage with exciting product innovations in Amazon Devices. Through the platform, customers can request invitations to purchase invite-only products, or get notified about upcoming product launches. From the business perspective, this enables product owners to gradually collect user feedback and iterate on a product with different invitation waves, as well as gauge interest in unreleased products.
positions.insights: System Architecture, Distributed Systems and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer - Smart Vehicles
positions.description:
- Involved in developing embedded system software for General Motors' Onstar telematics project
- Developed embedded automotive software(C/C++) in Linux ARM cross-compile environment for General Motors Onstar telematics
- Created NAND flash analyzer tool to detect bit-flip errors, ECC errors, and bad blocks which decreased debugging time by 30% 
- Created embedded Linux middleware-OS libraries(API) which ensures fast and reliable work for concurrent applications

honors.title: Amazon Ads Sponsored Product Spotlight Award
Amazon Devices Sales and Marketing Spot Award
honors.description: We recognize Ji An for her strong demonstration of ownership and insist on the highest standards in the past month. She has stepped in to own the full launch strategy and launch execution of the new Invite Admin UI as well as the consolidation of Invite program related data tables. This is critical work as it involves deployments which need to happen synchronously across multiple pipelines, migration of data across DB tables while live programs are running, and AppConfig switches to change logic on a significant number of APIs which currently serve customer traffic. She was able to come up with a plan which minimizes all risks and also dedicated a significant amount of time over the holidays to execute in depth testing to catch bugs and ensure no issues during launch while QA was OOO. Overall, we just had successful launches without any issues thanks to Ji An working over the clock to ensure everything is done with care and quality.

volunteerExperiences.description: Notetaking services are provided to students registered with the Accessible Education Center (AEC), whose disability impairment(s) prevent the student from taking notes during course lecture. Notetaking services are provided to begin to eliminate the competitive disadvantage under which students with disabilities function; however, it is impossible to fully compensate for a disability.
